description: Authoritative strict crossing-policy audit of the 8 frozen V3-Huang dual-height plane runs (A/B/C/D x z1/z2).  Same strict policy as the FSLW round (abcd/SPEC.md section 2.1, clearance 0.080 mm, lim 0.0799999); V3 adds same/opposite/adjacent relation classes and the same-side U/hairpin 180-degree arc family.  Each plane is an independent 2D problem; cross-plane XY projections are not same-layer conflicts.

failure_taxonomy.note: Failed identities are connections for which the router found no legal fixed-R=40 candidate under the frozen strict policy.  They are reported as failed (not routed) and are NOT violations of the accepted geometry: the independent audit of the routed primitives finds zero violations. Same-side U/hairpin loops often fail with double_cross/spacing/tangent_touch at the strict-policy geometric limit -- a real geometric result.
